<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:2">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>ק׳ קריא ברומי וכ׳</he> when the horn calls in (the market of) Rome, son of a trader in figs, sell thy father’s figs (wait not for thy father’s return, if he is absent).
<cite ref="Makkot 16b">Macc. 16ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>ק׳ דאומנא</he> the surgeon’s horn (in which he receives the blood); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קרְנִין</he>, <he>קַרְנֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 22:11">Targ. I Kings XXII, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:32">Targ. Ps. LXIX, 32</cite> (v.
<cite ref="Chullin 60a:7">Ḥull. 60ᵃ</cite>, quoted in <cite ref="S02102">preced.</cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 154b">Sabb. 154ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ דאומנא</he>, v. supra.

<cite ref="Shabbat 129b:12">Ib. 129ᵇ</cite> <he>מאה ק׳ בזוזא וכ׳</he> Ar. a. Ms. O. (ed. <cite ref="S02017"><he>קרי</he></cite>, v. Tosaf. a. l.) a hundred horns (hundred blood-lettings) for a Zuz, a hundred heads (hair-cuttings) for a Zuz, a hundred lips (trimmings of mustaches) for nothing.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 74a:7">B. Bath. 74ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 21:9">Targ. Prov. XXI, 9</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 111a:15">Keth. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>וקרו לה ק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>ליה</he>) and they shall call it (Babylonia) the corner of salvation.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 27b:9">B. Kam. 27ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="P01133"><he>עַצְרָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 34a:4">Men. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>פיתחא דאַקַּ׳</he> a door at the corner (having only one post); a. e.—Pl. <he>קַרְנִין</he>, <he>קַרְנָתָא</he>, <he>קַרְנָאתָא</he>; constr. <cite ref="S02110"><he>קַרְנַת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 29:12">Targ. Ex. XXIX, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 30:10">Ib. XXX, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 69:13">Targ. Ps. LXIX, 13</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Batra 95b">B. Bath. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>דמיזדבין אק׳</he> which is sold at the street-corners.

<cite ref="Pesachim 12b:7">Pes. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>שית יומא בי ק׳ קאי</he> (not <he>בק׳</he>) at six hours (at noon) the sun stands between the corners (of the globe, equally distant from east and west &c.).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 79a:8">B. Mets. 79ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 3a:8">B. Kam. 3ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00717"><he>כְּלֵי</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 2:3:2">Y. M. Kat. II, 81ᵇ</cite> top <he>אגרא וק׳ קרן הוא וכ׳</he> the expected profit and the principal (cost price) are together considered as principal &c.; a. e.—[<he>קרנא זול</he>, v. <cite ref="S02107"><he>קַרְנָזוֹל</he></cite>.]
